panel.subtitle: Train the catgirl to play games: AI searches gameplay, builds an operation library, then executes your goals with feedback loops.
panel.llm.title: LLM Settings
panel.llm.help: The text model plans goals/operations/feedback; the vision model reads screenshots. Leaving the text config blank falls back to the main system cloud config.
panel.llm.visionHelp: Vision model (used to read screenshots in the feedback loop; optional)
panel.learn.title: Learn a new game
panel.learn.help: AI searches the game's gameplay/controls/walkthroughs via MCP multi-engine search (mcp-search-server) and generates an interface config draft (input operations + observable info). Requires mcp_adapter configured with that server.
panel.learn.name: Game name
panel.learn.tip: Confirm the draft in Game Management below, then generate the operation library.
panel.games.title: Game Management
panel.games.help: Drafts must be confirmed before playing; after confirmation you can generate the operation library.
panel.games.empty: No games learned yet. Start with Learn a new game above.
panel.games.name: Game
panel.play.title: Start Playing
panel.play.help: The catgirl turns your goal into action sequences, executes in segments with screenshot feedback, and adjusts until done.
